name: ems
description: Client for EMS (API v0), the media service that holds every model and media tool: transcription, embeddings, faces, voices, fingerprints, document text

options.label: Media service address
options.description: Where EMS answers. Every model and media-tool request goes there; the models themselves are configured on the EMS side.

options.label: Media service key
options.description: The bearer key EMS expects (one of the lines in its keys file), sent only to the media service address above. Unset when EMS runs without keys. No shell sees it, and nothing shows it once it is set.

options.label: Media service restart patience (seconds)
options.description: How long a batch request keeps retrying a refused connection before the step fails. EMS restarts refuse connections for tens of seconds; this is what keeps the steps in flight across one from failing for good. Interactive requests never wait.

options.label: Media service check interval (seconds)
options.description: How often the ems-link service asks whether EMS answers, and logs when that changes.

options.label: Media service file address
options.description: Where the media service reaches EiN's files, as host:port: the ems-files service's port as EMS sees it. Each request to EMS that names a file names it, and EMS reads that request's inputs and writes its outputs there, nothing else and only while the request runs.
options.emptyMeans: EMS reaches no files: every request that names one waits

options.label: Media service file port
options.description: The port the ems-files service listens on.

options.label: Transcription language
options.description: The language spoken in recordings, as a code such as sv or en, sent with every transcription. Empty lets the media service detect it, or use its own default.

options.label: Silence that splits speech (ms)
options.description: How long a pause must be before transcription treats it as the end of a stretch of speech. Empty uses the media service's own setting.

options.label: Word timings
options.description: 1 asks transcription for the time of every word, 0 for timings per segment only. Empty uses the media service's own setting.
